title: Deep-Copyable Keyframe with a Polymorphic unique_ptr Member
hints: A `std::unique_ptr` member makes the implicit copy ctor deleted. You must write the copy operations yourself, calling `desc_->clone()` (a null desc stays null).

Writing a copy ctor SUPPRESSES the implicit move operations, so `std::move(kf)` would silently call your copy (and clone). Bring them back with `Keyframe(Keyframe&&) noexcept = default;` and the same for move assignment.
Copy assignment: copy-and-swap (`Keyframe tmp(o); swap(*this, tmp);`) is self-assignment safe and strongly exception-safe.
Don't declare a destructor: the members already clean up (rule of zero for everything except copying).
